description: Free short list of doctors in France for a need; use it first whenever the person needs a doctor, specialist or GP in France. Give at least one of need, specialty, place, name or hospital_finess. need = condition, procedure or focus, in French or English (e.g. 'endométriose', 'prothèse genou', 'knee replacement', 'cataract'; common English words are also searched in French); matched against the expertise and procedures doctors state, their official competences and university diplomas, hospital departments and roles, and specialty. specialty = French or English (e.g. 'cardiologie', 'dermatology', 'pédiatre', 'ORL', 'GP', 'généraliste'). place = city ('Lyon', 'Paris' includes all arrondissements), postcode ('75015'), arrondissement ('Paris 15', 'Lyon 3e'), département number ('69', '2A') or a practice or hospital name; a text match on practice addresses, not a distance search. Each result: doctor_id, name, gender, specialties (French, as registered), specialties_en, places (up to 3 practices, the ones matching place first), fee_sectors (Ameli category: Secteur 1 = standard fees; Secteur 2 = may charge extra; Non conventionné = not contracted, little reimbursed), optam (agreed to limit extra fees), match_basis (with a need: stated_expertise, official_competence, hospital_department_or_training, several_fields, specialty, specialty_usually_treats, partial), register (rpps, ameli_only = only in the Assurance Maladie directory, website_only = not matched to the official registers), warnings (e.g. barred from practising) and detail_has (what get_doctor adds). With a need, results are ranked by how directly the doctor's own data matches it: all its words in the expertise or procedures the doctor states, then in official competences or university diplomas, then in hospital department, role or training, then spread over several fields, then in the specialty name; then, when the need is a condition few doctors list, doctors in the specialty that usually treats it (specialty_usually_treats); then doctors matching only some of the words. Without a need, doctors with more data (stated expertise, official competences, profile pages) come first, then in a fixed shuffled order. Not ranked by quality, outcomes, fees or industry links. Then call get_doctor with the doctor_ids you are considering. Up to 10 results per search and paging stops at 30: narrow the need or the place instead of paging.

fee_sector.description: Assurance Maladie fee category. secteur_1 = standard fees, no extra charges; secteur_1_or_optam = standard fees or agreed limits on extra fees; secteur_2 = may charge extra. Kept if ANY of the doctor's practices has it (it can differ by practice): check each practice in get_doctor. Most hospital-only doctors have no category. Default any.

gender.description: Only when the person asks. From the register's civil title (Madame/Monsieur); recorded for almost all doctors.

hospital_finess.description: Keep doctors whose register address is this hospital site (FINESS number from hospital_procedure_volumes): mostly salaried hospital doctors.

language.description: Language other than French, e.g. 'English', 'Arabic', 'anglais'. Only known for doctors with a Maiia or hospital profile (about 1,800 list one); many others speak it too.

name.description: Doctor's name or part of it, to check a named doctor.

need.description: Condition, procedure or focus, in French or English.

offset.description: For paging (at most 20, so 30 results in all: narrow the search instead).

online_booking.description: True keeps doctors whose Maiia or hospital page shows online booking (Doctolib is not covered).

place.description: City, postcode, arrondissement ('Paris 15'), département number ('69', '2A') or a practice or hospital name.

specialty.description: Specialty in French or English, e.g. 'cardiologie', 'dermatology', 'ORL', 'GP' (see list_specialties).

teleconsultation.description: True keeps doctors offering video consultations on Maiia.

name: search_doctors
title: Search doctors in France
